checklist: magick -version lists the built-in delegates freetype, jpeg, jp2, lcms, png, tiff, webp, xml, zlib (7.1.2-32-3: jng jp2 jpeg lcms png tiff only)
-list format: WEBP rw, MSL and MSVG readable (libxml2; 7.1.2-32-3: MSL ---, MSVG -w+), TTF readable (freetype; absent in -3)
logo: to WEBP and back: identify WEBP 160 120, a lossless webp converts to PNG 160 120
freetype: -annotate with a Type 1 font (wasm-poppler's Nimbus Sans) draws dark pixels on a white canvas, a blank canvas none

libxml2: an SVG with a red and a blue rect renders through the internal MSVG coder (255,0,0 at 5,5, 0,0,255 at 30,10); an MSL script (magick msl:script null:) reads logo:, resizes to 64x48 and writes a PNG

resource policy (policy.mjs): the default etc/ImageMagick-7/policy.xml is the tab policy (width/height 64KP, area 64MP, memory 1536MiB, map 256MiB, disk 0, from -list resource); magick -size 30000x30000 xc:white (900 MP) fails within seconds, rc 1, 'cache resources exhausted' (area), no trap, no file; 70000x10 fails with 'width or height exceeds limit'; 9000x9000 (81MP) fails with 'cache resources exhausted'; -limit cannot raise a policy limit; 12, 24 and 48 MP canvases (4000x3000, 6000x4000, 8064x6048) resize 50% and 25% to the right size, each within 30 s (homescoop#356: with disk 512MiB the 48 MP resize spilled to the disk cache and hung for minutes); homescoop#445: an 18000x3000 (54 MP) panorama JPEG made with magick-open gives '18000 3000' from identify -format '%w %h' and resizes with plain magick -resize 2000x to 2000x333, and a 1000x20000 canvas resizes 10% to 100x2000 (7.1.2-34-1, width/height 16KP: 'width or height exceeds limit', rc 1); magick-open and MAGICK_CONFIGURE_PATH=<package>/etc/ImageMagick-7-open lift the limits (a 70000x10 canvas works there and fails under the tab policy)

mogrify.mjs (7.1.2-34, homescoop#353, ImageMagick#9011): mogrify -resize 50% a.png b.jpg rewrites both files in place (200x150), rc 0, no output, no other files. 7.1.2-33: 'no encode delegate for this image format `'', rc 1, files unchanged

wasm-check.mjs (ladder-pr ci, homescoop#593, #396): bin/magick.wasm has a name section and no DWARF (.debug_*), the tarball has no share/ (no relink kit), README.md's Relinking section points to @ai-ecoverse/wasm-imagemagick-relink, package.json says homescoop.relink @ai-ecoverse/wasm-imagemagick-relink and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md names @ai-ecoverse/wasm-imagemagick-relink@<this version> (homescoop#678), which holds the kit (share/imagemagick/relink) at the same version; packages/imagemagick-relink's relink-check relinks it. 7.1.2-34-4: DWARF (.debug_info 3.2 MB) and the kit in share/

build (homescoop#350): build.sh configures again a $WORK tree configured with other delegates, or built with other configure arguments or link flags (.homescoop-build stamp), and checks, outside the configure skip, that config.h has webp, freetype and xml and no heic, and that magick.wasm has no libheif (no heif_ symbols)

inplace-webp.mjs (homescoop#585, webp-check-size-before-open.patch): writing an image over 16383 px a side to WebP fails rc 1 with 'width or height exceeds limit' before the output is opened: magick w.webp -resize 200% w.webp keeps w.webp (WEBP 9000 100), an 18000x3000 panorama or a 100x17000 canvas written over pano.webp keeps it, magick-open the same, and no new.webp appears; 16383x10 and a 17000x1000 image resized to 16383x (16383x964) write. 7.1.2-34-2: w.webp truncated to nothing

no build paths (homescoop#937, cert/lib/wasm-check.mjs): no file of the tarball holds the build checkout, .homescoop-out, /home/runner/work or the emsdk path; etc/ImageMagick-7*/configure.xml names the delegate prefix as /prefix and emsdk as /emsdk (build.sh rewrites both files and fails if a build path is left). 7.1.2-34-7: five configure.xml entries hold the runner's checkout path (NEGATIVE.md)

atomic-write.mjs (7.1.2-34-9.1, homescoop#562, write-temp-then-rename.patch): a single output file is written to <target>.xxxxxxxx~ and renamed over the target only once the write succeeded. A -depth 8 PNG write that fails with 'cache resources exhausted' (2000x1000 gradient under -limit memory 20MiB -limit map 0) exits 1, leaves an existing orig.png byte-identical and creates no new.png, with no *~ left; a good write still replaces the target, and an adjoined two-frame GIF keeps both frames. 7.1.2-34-9 overwrites orig.png on the failed write (NEGATIVE.md)

mogrify.mjs (7.1.2-34-9.1, homescoop#624, mogrify-format-over-existing.patch): mogrify -format webp s.png and -format jpg s.png over an existing s.webp / s.jpg write WEBP 100 50 and JPEG 100 50 with WEBP (RIFF....WEBP) and JPEG (ff d8 ff) magic bytes, and leave no stray files. 7.1.2-34-9 writes PNG bytes under the new name (NEGATIVE.md)
7.1.2-34-9.1 (homescoop#819): the cert runs with users enforce

atomic-write.mjs (7.1.2-34-9.1, homescoop#1244): only single-file raster coders (PNG, JPEG, WEBP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, PNM, HEIC, JXL, JP2, QOI, TGA, ICON, PSD), named by extension or the same explicit prefix, take the temp-and-rename path; -write mpr:notes +delete mpr:notes reads the register back and leaves a cwd file named notes unchanged, and an unknown prefix (co:lon.png) writes co:lon.png as upstream does

defaults.mjs (7.1.2-34-9.2, homescoop#586): magick -pointsize 20 label:hi and -annotate +10+50 hi without -font draw text with the packaged default font (gsfonts' URW Nimbus Sans as Helvetica in etc/fonts, named by type.xml in etc/ImageMagick-7 and -open); magick -list font shows Helvetica. 7.1.2-34-9.1: 'unable to read font `''', rc 1 (NEGATIVE.md)

defaults.mjs (homescoop#1208): the tab policy refuses MPC/CACHE (MPC persists the pixel cache to disk, which disk=0 forbids) with 'not authorized by the security policy `MPC''' and no out.mpc/out.cache; magick-open writes o.mpc and reads it back to a 30x30 PNG. 7.1.2-34-9.1: 'cache resources exhausted … unable to persist pixel cache' (NEGATIVE.md)

defaults.mjs (homescoop#679, timer-monotonic-emscripten.patch): identify rose: logo: prints an elapsed time 0:ss.mmm; Emscripten's clock_gettime refuses CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW, so 7.1.2-34-9.1 printed an uninitialized timespec (4294967295:10.000)

defaults.mjs (homescoop#561, jp2-tile-large.patch): a 16000x3000 (48 MP) gradient encodes to JP2 16000x3000; without -extract, images above 16 MP are encoded in 1024x1024 tiles. 7.1.2-34-9.1: 'unable to encode image file', rc 1

7.1.2-34-9.3: built against wasm-libpng 1.6.59-4, wasm-libwebp 1.6.0-4, wasm-libtiff 4.7.2-4, wasm-libxml2 2.15.4-3, wasm-lcms2 2.19.1-4, wasm-freetype 2.13.3-4 and wasm-libiconv 1.19.0-3 (npm latest; no build paths, libwebp.pc Requires libsharpyuv, homescoop#941, #925)

mogrify-users.mjs (7.1.2-34-9.5, homescoop#1381, mogrify-inplace-keep-mode-owner.patch, write-temp-then-rename.patch): in-place mogrify -resize 50% keeps the file's mode, group and owner, and a failed write never touches the file. As kim (groups kim, users) over her own 0644 kim:users a.png and 0640 b.png: kim users 644 and kim kim 640, resized; as root over kim's 0644 a.png and 0664 kim:users c.jpg: still kim users 644 and 664; as kim over root's 0666 w.png in a sticky /tmp/msk and an open /tmp/mop: resized, root root 666. A failed encode (mogrify -limit memory 24MiB -limit map 0 -depth 8, 'cache resources exhausted') over kim's own 0644 big.png (the rename path) and over root's 0666 big.png in both directories (the copy path) exits 1 and leaves the bytes (cksum), mode and owner; so does kim's failing magick -depth 8 write over root's file. mogrify over a symlink l.png -> real.png keeps the link, and real.png (kim users 640) gets the new image. No stray files anywhere. 7.1.2-34-9.4: kim kim 600, root root 600, a sticky-dir backup left behind, the link replaced by a 0600 file, and the failing magick write truncates root's file (NEGATIVE.md)

wasm-check.mjs (7.1.2-34-9.5, homescoop#1382): etc/fonts holds gsfonts .pfb files, so etc/fonts/README (gsfonts' README: 'GPL with an exception that you can put these fonts in your own non-GPLed documents') and etc/fonts/COPYING (GPL version 2) ship, THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md carries the exception, and package.json license names GPL-2.0-only WITH Font-exception-2.0. 7.1.2-34-9.4: no README in etc/fonts (NEGATIVE.md)

write-temp-then-rename.patch (7.1.2-34-9.5, homescoop#1381): HomescoopPrepareReplace gives the temporary file the target's owner, group and mode (fchown, fchmod, then fstat to verify) right after creating it; HomescoopReplaceFile renames it over the target only if that held, the target is the same inode (lstat dev/ino) and has one link; otherwise (another user's file, a group or mode it can't set, a hard-linked file, a symlink) the finished image is copied into the target, opened without O_TRUNC (O_NOFOLLOW unless the target was a symlink, fstat dev/ino checked), then ftruncated to its size. The #1258 in-place write of another user's target is gone: a failed write leaves it as it was

patches.webp-check-size-before-open.patch: homescoop#585: upstream WriteWEBPImage opened (truncated) the output before refusing an image over WebP's 16383 px a side, so magick w.webp -resize 200% w.webp destroyed w.webp; the patch refuses before OpenBlob. inplace-webp.mjs: in place, a panorama over an existing .webp and magick-open all fail rc 1 with 'width or height exceeds limit' and leave the file as it was, no new file appears, and 16383 px still writes. Without it the first case fails (NEGATIVE.md)
